topic: Someone discovers their partner has been writing a novel about them
text: Finding out that my partner has been penning a novel about our life, our journey, took my breath away. It’s not every day that someone spends their time crafting stories, pouring their heart into the pages just to capture the essence of us. I read through the chapters, each word a surprise, each paragraph painting a picture I thought only we shared. The depth, the insight, it’s humbling. It’s like they’ve been carrying these moments, these feelings, close to their heart, and now they're gifting them to me. I feel seen, understood, cherished. This novel isn’t just a story; it’s a pledge of sorts, a testament to the life we’ve built together.
